'''Yablari''' was an agrarian [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector's]] [[Yablari system/Legends|Yablari system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], Yablari's agricultural technology was highly advanced and prolific.

==Description==
Yablari was home to the native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]], who were known as wealthy pacifists. The world was also predominantly used as an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]]. While the world was sometimes prone to mass droughts, the land was fertile and good for growing plants.<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
Joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] early in its history, sometime between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the planet's native Anomid's had discovered [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] technology centuries before being discovered. Driven to search for fertile soils offworld during a severe drought, the Anomids' first encounter with alien life was a world which hosted a small [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] colony. Opening the world to galactic trade was the paving of the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], which allowed curious Anomid to leave the world and begin a 15,000 year long period of mass social and cultural adventurism.<ref name="UAA" />

During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], the [[Krath/Legends|Krath]] [[Battle of the Yablari system|laid siege]] to the planet's star system and was able to emerge victorious after open conflict with Republic forces there. While the Sith were driven off at the conclusion of the war, decades later the planet was annexed by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].

The Anomids' Central Council later agreed to support the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for the good of their people. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives, on the other hand, liked to befriend Anomid travelers who might be persuaded to give money to the cause. Some Rebel safeworlds used Anomid food technology to stretch limited supplies.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref>
